rationale: This is the minimal concrete membership declaration for a deterministic initial wave. The values reference the canonical shard definitions in runs[].shards and let order derive wave position without duplicating per-wave execution details. Each declared initial wave must contain this field; an empty or absent selector would not be a viable wave.
alternatives: derive from a separate wave-size rule, but that would not preserve a deterministic initial allocation
store shard objects, but that duplicates canonical shard definitions
simplestChoice: Keep shard_digests as the required ordered shard selector on each initial wave.
